description: Stable JSON envelope for all CLI --json output (promoted at v3.7.2).
invariants: error field is OMITTED when null (not present in serialized JSON)
error field is PRESENT when non-null
data is always a JSON object (never null, never a primitive)
status is one of: success, error, cancelled, pass, fail
command is the CLI command name string (e.g. ask, edit, apply, fix)
